agent.finish_summary: Fixed IndexError: pop from empty list regression in sqlparse/engine/statement_splitter.py. The `_handle_closing_keyword` method's bare 'END' branch had inverted condition logic (`if not (self._block_stack): self._block_stack.pop()`), causing pop-from-empty-list whenever a CASE...END statement (or similar block-closing END) was parsed. Changed to `if self._block_stack: self._block_stack.pop()` to match the pattern of all other closing-keyword branches (END IF, END FOR, END WHILE, END LOOP, END CASE). Verified via manual reindent/reindent_aligned/nested-CASE/BEGIN-CASE-END formatting tests — all now work correctly without raising.
